services.name: Camp
services.desc: The mission of CCA's Summer Art Camp is for each child to have a rich variety of art experiences. Every day campers will participate in 2-4 classes (half/full day) in drawing, painting, sculpture, ceramic art and theatre. Some projects will be completed in one day while others may build through several class sessions. Campers will be amazed to see what they can create in just two weeks! Each session will be based upon a theme. In the past we've explored art from other countries, local animals and their habitats, and flight.
